name: Atrys Health, S.A.
summary: Atrys Health, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides diagnostic services and medical treatments in Spain, Portugal, and Latin America. It operates through three segments: Diagnosis, Oncology, and Preventive Medicine. The company offers integrated diagnostics services comprising structural and molecular pathology, genetics, and nuclear medicine diagnosis; telediagnosis activities in the fields of radiology and cardiology; oncology treatment services, such as chemotherapy, immunotherapy, radiotherapy, and brachytherapy; second opinion and genetic counselling; and diagnostic reports and genetic tests.
